message.content:
The sequence is the Fibonacci sequence with \(t_0=0,\ t_1=1\).

Modulo \(7\), the Fibonacci sequence has period \(16\):

\[
\begin{aligned}
t_0,t_1,\dots,t_{15} &\equiv 0,1,1,2,3,5,1,6,0,6,6,5,4,2,6,1 \pmod 7.
\end{aligned}
\]

Since \(a\equiv 5\pmod{16}\), \(b\equiv 10\pmod{16}\), and \(c\equiv 15\pmod{16}\),

\[
\begin{aligned}
t_a &\equiv t_5 \equiv 5 \pmod 7,\\
t_b &\equiv t_{10} \equiv 6 \pmod 7,\\
t_c &\equiv t_{15} \equiv 1 \pmod 7.
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus,

\[
t_a+t_b+t_c \equiv 5+6+1=12\equiv 5 \pmod 7.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{5}\).
